headline: Ola Electric Mobility Limited: News Verification
sum: News Verification — The Exchange has sought clarification from Ola Electric Mobility Limited with respect to recent news item captioned Ola Electric plans Rs 2,000 cr fundraise for battery arm. The response from the Company is awaited.
